detailed_descriptions.en: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice . Set in a world broken by a magical disaster, you lead a group of wanderers through dangerous, ever-changing lands. In Sigilfarer , your strength isn’t just your strategy — it’s the dice you create. The game is built around a unique dice system that reimagines deck-building. Your party is your dice set. Every weapon, shield, and piece of armor you equip changes your dice, adding new faces that define your attacks, defenses, and abilities. Sigilfarer reimagines the deck-building genre, allowing you to shape your own destiny with a customizable dice system . Your party is the dice set ; each sword, shield, and armor you equip becomes a die face, determining the attacks, buffs, and strategic options available to you. Manage up to four characters in your team, creating unique builds and synergies tailored to your playstyle . The dice are crucial during the whole playthrough and represent abilities of the party. Roll your dice in tactical turn-based combat , use them to overcome skill checks, and use them to renew resources while resting. Every dice throw can turn the tide! In this roguelite adventure , you'll rely on your wits and the dice you craft to explore procedurally generated, open hexagonal maps. Each region presents diverse biomes, perils, and opportunities . Conducted runs will push you to develop your strategy and enhance your dice set with each attempt. Death is not the end, but rather a fresh beginning , allowing you to become stronger and wiser with each journey. What does Sigilfarer offer: - Roguelite Gameplay Loop - Dice Rolling - Engaging Story - Turn-Based Combat - Little Bit of Luck - High Replay Value - Many unlockables and more to come - Atmospheric Gameplay - Lot of goblins and other creatures What does Sigilfarrer NOT offer: - Relaxing Gameplay - 4x Strategy - City Building
